entities.name: Gilles Ségal
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gilles Ségal was a French actor, mime, and playwright. He performed on stage with Marcel Marceau, and in more than sixty films since 1954. He was born in Fălticeni, Romania. Among his most notable roles is that of one of the heist participants in Jules Dassin's Topkapi.
